traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The bulette's long jump is up to 30 ft. and its high jump is up to 15 ft., with or without a running start. (Descriptive only: those distances are not checked. Strength jump limits, a running start, and high jump are not checked. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.description: If the bulette jumps at least 15 ft. as part of its movement, it can then use this action to land on its feet in a space that contains one or more other creatures. Each of those creatures must succeed on a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be knocked prone and take 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a successful save, the creature takes only half the damage, isn't knocked prone, and is pushed 5 ft. out of the bulette's space into an unoccupied space of the creature's choice. If no unoccupied space is within range, the creature instead falls prone in the bulette's space. (The built-in AI does not leap. Strength jump limits, a running start, and high jump are not checked. See docs/CONTENT_CONVENTIONS.md §38.)
